2. [✓] Retrieve canonical protein sequences (FASTA + flat file)

**Results**

| Gene | UniProt | Length | UniProt mass | Recomputed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| COLEC11 | Q9BWP8 | 271 aa | 28.665 kDa | 28.665 kDa |
| NRL | P54845 | 237 aa | 25.940 kDa | 25.940 kDa |

COLEC11 (Collectin-11) is heavier than NRL (Neural retina-specific leucine zipper protein).

**Data check notes:** A field-filtered UniProt REST call for NRL (`?fields=...`) returned an internally inconsistent record claiming `sequence.length = 284` and `molWeight = 31128` while the returned sequence string was 237 aa. The authoritative flat-file record (`ID NRL_HUMAN Reviewed; 237 AA`, `SQ ... 237 AA; 25940 MW`) and both isoforms (P54845-1 = 237 aa; P54845-2 = 98 aa) confirm 237 aa / 25.94 kDa, so I used that. The margin is also thin and depends on the convention chosen: COLEC11 is a secreted precursor with a 1–25 signal peptide, and the mature chain (26–271) is 26.107 kDa — still heavier than NRL's 25.94 kDa, but by only ~0.17 kDa. Masses are UniProt apo-sequence values and exclude post-translational modifications (COLEC11 is disulfide-linked homotrimeric in vivo).
